raw_text: Tens of thousands of Sri Lankans took to the streets of Colombo in the largest protest since the 2022 uprising that toppled President Rajapaksa. Demonstrators are demanding the government renegotiate IMF austerity conditions that have led to soaring food and fuel prices. Security forces used tear gas and water cannons, arresting at least 40 protesters. The IMF said it is monitoring the situation closely.
